answer: Locks are entered in ember, expire in river, and mirror lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 29 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Anyone running 139 aliases thus needs 46 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2915 identities would post 921 proofs and burn roughly 64 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
